title: 0 Of 7 Brain Networks Supported The Personality Myth
hook: Scientists tested 7 brain networks. None behaved left-brained or right-brained.
closing: Your brain works as one team, so personality cannot belong to only one side.
question: Were you labeled left-brained or right-brained?

segments.say: Language sits about 96 percent in the left side for right-handers. Personality does not split by side.
Scientists tested 7 brain networks, and none matched the left-brain, right-brain myth.
About 200 million nerve fibers link the brain's halves. Both sides constantly share signals.
